title: Scaffolding tooling for new instantsearch.js projects
body:
Would be nice to have a tool to bootstrap a new instantsearch.js. Simple command line stuff like `instantsearch new` that would ask a few questions (not mandatory in the beginning) : 
- name of the project
- which css framework to use : bootstrap / foundation / none
- which build system : browserify / webpack / simple html (use script from jsDeliver)

comments.body: I would rather go for a (some) simple GitHub skeleton project(s) like `algolia/instantsearch-bootstrap-webpack-skeleton` rather than a command line tool. Or better: a [yeoman](http://yeoman.io/) template.
Building the `instantsearch-starter-kit` repo will in the end be useful if one want to create an instantsearch cli scafolding app. Because it can reuse the repo I guess.
